# Block entity data through setblock/data (needs the chest block entity: BlocksScope).
# scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/block_entities.txt
setblock 0 -50 0 chest{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:stone",count:3}]}
data get block 0 -50 0
data get block 0 -50 0 Items
data get block 0 -50 0 Items[0].count
data get block 0 -50 0 Items[0].count 2
data get block 0 -50 0 nothing
data modify block 0 -50 0 Items[0].count set value 9
data get block 0 -50 0 Items[0].count
data modify block 0 -50 0 CustomName set value '{"text":"named"}'
data get block 0 -50 0 CustomName
data merge block 0 -50 0 {Lock:"key"}
data get block 0 -50 0 lock
data remove block 0 -50 0 Items[0]
data get block 0 -50 0 Items
setblock 0 -50 0 air
